finding.title: OS Command Injection
finding.trigger: An attacker can inject a filename that includes shell metacharacters or control operators.
finding.assumptions: The code does not sanitize or validate the 'filename' input before using it to open a file. The operating system may execute unintended commands if the filename includes shell metacharacters.
